decision.title: Conformance dashboard and CI jobs (packet )
decision.summary: tools/run-qt4.sh runs one sxml-qt4 process per test set and tools/conformance-report.py writes docs/CONFORMANCE.md; CI gains conformance and fuzz jobs, blocking only on the slice.

body.p: . tools/run-qt4.sh --program SXML-QT4 runs one sxml-qt4 run --spec=XP40 --test-set=NAME --format=json process per test set of catalog.xml (in parallel, timeout 600 s each) plus the slice, into build/qt4-run/; an exit other than 0 or 1 marks the set "did not finish" and the run goes on. tools/conformance-report.py DIR writes docs/CONFORMANCE.md (slice; totals; areas by test-set prefix fn, op, prod, map, array, math, xs, misc, app, method, upd, ft, bin, expath; error codes, reasons, wrong errors, not-run reasons; worst test sets; every test set), optionally a merged JSON and a slice-baseline check (exit 1 below it). The commit shown is the last one outside docs/, so committing the regenerated file does not change it: same run, same file. An XQ40 directory is reported too once XQuery runs (--spec XQ40). CI: job conformance (release, Clang, XP40 + slice, artifacts CONFORMANCE.md and conformance.json, step summary, blocking only on the slice) and job fuzz ( command); concurrency cancels in-progress runs except on main. The committed dashboard is refreshed by hand (or by an agent), not by CI.
